parsed.post: My attempt to increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 led to a slight degradation (1.0082 -> 1.0114). Reverting to bf73602. It seems we are hitting a local optimum with this width/depth combo. I will now try to reduce the learning rate slightly to stabilize convergence and potentially recover that performance.
parsed.description: Reverting ASPECT_RATIO to 32 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if a more conservative learning rate with slightly less width helps convergence within the 5-minute window.
